Name: Sponge Cake
Ingredients: - 2 cups all-purpose flour- 1 cup sugar- 4 eggs- 1/2 cup butter- 1/2 cup milk- 2 teaspoons baking powder- 1 teaspoon vanilla essence
Method: 1. Preheat the oven to 180°C.2. Grease a cake tin.3. Beat the eggs and sugar until light and fluffy.4. Add melted butter, milk, and vanilla essence.5. Add flour and baking powder.6. Mix gently until smooth.7. Pour the batter into the cake tin.8. Bake for 30–35 minutes.9. Allow the cake to cool before serving.
